text: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said,
When the morning stars sang together And all the sons of God (angels) shouted for joy?
"Their light is withheld from the wicked, And the uplifted arm is broken.
"Have you understood the expanse of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.
"Where is the way that the light is distributed, Or the east wind scattered over the earth?
"Water becomes like stone [and hides itself], And the surface of the deep is frozen and imprisoned.
"Do you know the ordinances of the heavens, Or [can you] establish their rule over the earth?
When the dust hardens into a mass And the clods stick together [because of the heat]?
"Who provides prey for the raven When its young cry to God And wander about without food?
